units.source_text: 因此，性就像结草虫，被证书的大氅盖得严严实实。

en.t: Thus, sex was like a bagworm, tightly covered by the great cloak of certificates.

units.source_text: 要是称心的话，这样也不错嘛。

en.t: If it was satisfying, then that was not so bad either.

units.source_text: 然而，证书难道就此了结吗？

en.t: And yet, could the certificates really end there?

units.source_text: ……难道就没有什么忘了证明的吗？

en.t: ...Was there really nothing that had been forgotten and left unproved?

units.source_text: ……男人、女人都成了暗暗猜疑的俘虏：

en.t: ...Both the man and the woman became prisoners of secret suspicion:

units.source_text: 对方该不是故意草草了事吧？

en.t: Could the other person have deliberately done it in a perfunctory way?

units.source_text: ……为了表示清白，他们得苦思冥想新的“证书”……

en.t: ...To prove their innocence, they had to rack their brains for new certificates...

units.source_text: 谁也不知道在哪里还有最后一张……

en.t: No one knew where the final one might still be...
The certificates seemed to be endless...
